title: Amazon Product Image Requirements | AIVideosUGC
description: Amazon product image requirements: a compliant white background, with the product large in the frame. Download the file and add it in Seller Central.
h1: Amazon Listing Photos That Follow Image Requirements
lead: From one photo you already have, meet Amazon product image requirements: a white main image, a detail, and an in-use view. Repeat that set across the catalog. A batch can do the rest. The cost shows before each file.
card: Amazon listing photos from one product photo: main, detail and in-use.

faq.q: What should your Amazon main image show so the listing can go up?
faq.a: The main image is the product on pure white, filling about eighty-five percent of the square. Make the long edge 1000 pixels or more, so zoom still looks sharp. No words, logos, or props. Save measurements for a later image, and publish the file in Seller Central after you check the current rule.

faq.q: What happens to the listing if an Amazon photo breaks the image rules?
faq.a: A main photo that still shows the room can be held back, and the listing can leave search until you replace that file. A prop can sit on a later image, not on the main one.

faq.q: How do I get a white Amazon main image from a photo I already have?
faq.a: Upload the photo you already have and put the product on white. The old background comes off, the edges stay with the product, and you download a finished file. A photo is 24 credits, shown before you start.

faq.q: Can I prepare many Amazon photos in one run and skip a studio day?
faq.a: Yes. Send the whole line through one batch, lifestyle frames included. Each file spends credits, the cost shows first, and a failed job returns those credits. You can also run that batch through the API.

faq.q: Can my catalog tool make the Amazon images so I skip a studio day?
faq.a: Yes. When a new product is saved, your catalog tool can request the image through the API. You choose when it goes into Seller Central. We never sign in to the seller account.

faq.q: What other Amazon images should I add so shoppers understand the product?
faq.a: A close-up, a sense of size, and the item in use. The mug can sit in a hand so the shopper sees the scale.

faq.q: Can I put my own words on the pictures after I download them?
faq.a: Add the words yourself after download, and only on images after the main one. The main image stays free of badges and slogans.

faq.q: Can I make a video for the Amazon listing without booking a shoot?
faq.a: Yes. A video is its own job at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, costing 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits.

faq.q: Will you upload the finished photos into Amazon for me?
faq.a: No. Download the files and add them in Seller Central yourself. We do not connect to your seller login.
